description:
FOUND s514 (Fable, 2026-10-10 12:41) by the s513g merge-review probe ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/p513g/tags.pl (perl -> base cc3caca6 -> s513g tree 499ffad6: base = tree, both die).  perl: `%EXPORT_TAGS = ( ALL => [ ,  ] )` (File/Spec/Functions.pm:36); the tag is a union of two LITERAL qw lists in the same file -- a static fact.  s513g's `_expand_import_tags` (Pl/Parser.pm) reads `import_sets`, which the walk fills only from literal `qw()` tags, so `:ALL` expands to nothing ("a tag the facts do not hold imports nothing").  FIX SHAPE (rule 11, the general mechanism): when the walk reads `%EXPORT_TAGS = (TAG => [ ... ])` whose elements are `` / `` (or `\`), expand them from the module's own already-read lists -- the idiom appears in File::Spec::Functions, Capture::Tiny (`all => \`, overlaid by s513g), Scalar::Util-style modules and many CPAN dists; a facts overlay for File::Spec::Functions is the per-module alternative but the idiom is general.  Guard: a fixture module with `ALL => [, ]` + `use Fx ':ALL'` calling an  name; perl-oracle row.  Not a drop (the call is emitted as a call to an undefined sub -> a run-time die), so the census does not see it; the detector (#2610) does not either (the sub IS installed by Exporter at run time -- the failure is the import, not the parse).

MEASURED s514 (Fable, 2026-10-10 14:5x, main 134ca17f = code 38b4192a, probes ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/p514b/exptag*.pl through probe.sh): THE PREMISE ABOVE IS FALSE -- the computed-tag idiom WORKS on main for a user module: Fx.pm (declared subs, `ALL => [ @EXPORT, @EXPORT_OK ]`, `use Fx :ALL`) prints a1b1c1 = perl; Fg.pm (GLOB-ASSIGNED subs in a foreach over @EXPORT/@EXPORT_OK, `ALL => [ @EXPORT_OK, @EXPORT ]` = File::Spec::Functions own spelling) prints <ga><gb><gc> = perl.  The discriminator is PCL OWN SHIM lib/File/Spec/Functions.pm (rule 9a): after a plain `use File::Spec::Functions;` (the DEFAULT list) main has canonpath ABSENT in main:: and `defined &File::Spec::Functions::canonpath` FALSE (perl: both true); exptag4.pl: even the default import dies on canonpath; rel2abs("q") runs only through the package-blind fallback (#2952).  FIX = the shim: define and export what perl module does (every name of perl @EXPORT / @EXPORT_OK, the :ALL tag); guard = the REAL module (exptag4 / exptag6 rows, perl oracle).  No Parser change.  Handed to s514b (filler 2) by message.
subject: SHIM GAP (re-targeted s514): PCL own lib/File/Spec/Functions.pm does not define/export canonpath (and others) -- `use File::Spec::Functions; canonpath(...)` dies on main with the DEFAULT list, `:ALL` too; a user module with the same computed-tag idiom works, so this is the shim, not the export scan
